walls.note: Plantage Middenlaan front, 14.45 m (facade ring edge 1). The brief panorama (2024-12-10) shows the house wrapped in scaffolding sheeting (temporary); read from the unwrapped 2021 rectified crop w01-210.alt.jpg (TMX7316010203-002047_pano_0000_001809, ~50 px/m, heights h = (452 - y) / 50) with the 2021 oblique TMX7316010203-002047_pano_0000_001806.

The brief's wall is the rear wing's south-east face (facade ring edge 4), behind the front block; its 2021 crop is a tree trunk and the oblique thumb shows only the front and the hip end. Plain brick shell with the 3DBAG roof.

South-east end of the front block under the hip (facade ring edge 2): the 2025 crop is a hedge and trees; the 2021 oblique shows dark brick under the hipped roof with the white cornice returning round the corner. Plain brick, cornice returned.
